name: wuji-of-lingering-fate-west-east-decline-sacrifice-no-mill
notes: Wuji of Lingering Fate (9cef7aknvn): 'you may sacrifice': declining keeps Wuji on the field and mills nobody.

rulesClauses: Whenever your Shifting Currents change from facing West to East, you may sacrifice Wuji of Lingering Fate. If you do, target player puts the top three cards of their deck into their graveyard.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The WujiMill handler milled with a loop of MZMove($target, "myDeck-0", "myGraveyard"). Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so "myDeck-0" resolved to the SAME removed slot on every iteration after the first and MZMove's "already removed" guard silently no-oped: only the top card was ever milled (live repro on HEAD: graveyard held Wuji + 1 milled card, deck 15 instead of 14). Fixed by calling the engine's MillCards() helper (distinct slots, honours the Purging Tempest / Sasha banish redirects) for the chosen player.
